responses.draft_cover_letter:
I’m excited about the Analytics Engineer role at Fable Books because it aligns directly with my experience delivering high‑performance SQL solutions. At my previous organization I owned the PostgreSQL data model, partitioned the invoices table and tuned queries, which lowered the 95th‑percentile API latency from 900 ms to 180 ms. This work demonstrates the advanced SQL expertise you require for building reliable data pipelines.

In my final‑year university project I applied Python and scikit‑learn to detect anomalies in card‑transaction data. The project sharpened my ability to explore large datasets, engineer features, and evaluate models—skills that translate well to data‑driven analysis and reporting.

I have also collaborated closely with engineering and product teams to improve system observability. By introducing Prometheus and Grafana dashboards, we cut incident detection time in half, showing my capacity to work with stakeholders to define and monitor key metrics that matter to the business.

While I have not yet used dbt or Looker/Tableau, I am eager to expand my toolkit in these areas and apply the same disciplined approach that has driven my past successes. I look forward to contributing to Fable Books’ analytics capabilities and helping turn data into actionable insight.
